name: Ribosome Extract (lifecycle-driven template extraction)
description: Activity-driven implementation of the ribosome pattern. Subscribes to lifecycle:activity:postExecution and treats template extraction as a shape-identifying counterpart to goal/activity — input shape lifecycle:activity:postExecution, output shapes extractedTemplate / learningSummary / goalEnd. Replaces the imperative ribosome calls that previously fired inline from activity.ts (recordExecutionTrace path), goal-processor.ts (4 sites: success extraction, cost-limit attempt, LLM-verified attempt, max-turns attempt), and improviser-resolver.ts (success + cost-limit paths). The chain has seven tasks: (1) acquire_trace_signature — http_fetch to activity-api /v2/impulses/resolve with pointer.type=executionTraceWithSignatures keyed by the just-completed executionId; (2) assess_quality — llm_completion_dispatch computes a quality score from the lifecycle payload + trace signature (success rate, task count, resolver tier mix, cost-per-output ratio, depth=0 check, author-skip check); (3) synthesize_template — llm_completion_dispatch renders an extractedTemplate JSON proposal from the trace signature + lifecycle payload; (4) validate_proposal — llm_completion_dispatch validates the proposal against compliance rules; (5) dispatch_write_attempt — http_fetch POST to activity-api /v2/impulses/resolve with pointer.type=activityTemplate_write, GATED on the applyExtraction variable (default false); (6) dispatch_write_succeeded — noop marker emitting an activityTemplate impulse only when the write succeeded; (7) emit_summary — llm_completion_dispatch summary. The applyExtraction default of false makes first-canary-deploy observe-only: the chain emits an extractedTemplate proposal impulse for downstream consumers (workbench, replace-activity, operator) without actually persisting the new template. Once enough proposal traces accumulate and the quality threshold is calibrated, applyExtraction can be flipped to true (per-template variable override) for autonomous registration. RECURSION SAFETY: this template's templateAuthor on the lifecycle payload is `ribosome-pattern`, so when the meta-activity itself emits postExecution at completion, the gate_extraction conditional skips because templateAuthor is matched against a documented skip list. SCHEMA: rewritten 2026-06-02 to use current resolver+config schema (llm_completion_dispatch + http_fetch) routing through goal-host-vessel→development-vessel proxies. Closes Idiom-6 gap 3.

variables.name: qualityThreshold
variables.description: Minimum quality score (0-1) required for synthesize_template to fire.

variables.name: applyExtraction
variables.description: When true, dispatch_write_attempt task fires `activityTemplate_write` to persist the synthesized template. Default false makes first-canary-deploy observe-only.

variables.name: synthesisMaxTokens
variables.description: Token budget for synthesize_template's LLM call.

variables.name: lifecycle
variables.description: Set automatically by the lifecycle dispatcher to the lifecycle:activity:postExecution payload merged with {executionId, shape}.

tasks.description: Fetch the just-completed execution's trace signature via http_fetch POST to activity-api /v2/impulses/resolve with pointer.type=executionTraceWithSignatures.
tasks.notes: Uses http_fetch (dev-vessel proxy) to POST to activity-api's canonical /v2/impulses/resolve endpoint with the executionTraceWithSignatures pointer. The http_fetch resolver auto-attaches METABOB_API_KEY for substrate-local hosts. The signature shape is context-budget-conscious. SHORT-CIRCUIT: when qualityEligible is false in the lifecycle payload, skip the whole chain.

tasks.description: LLM computes a quality score (0-1) from the trace signature + lifecycle payload.
tasks.notes: Mirrors the imperative `scoreTemplateQuality` in template-generator.ts. Returns a structured JSON envelope. The extractionEligible flag gates synthesize_template. SHORT-CIRCUIT: skips when acquire_trace_signature produced no useful trace data (substring-match on `"tasks"`).

tasks.description: LLM renders an `extractedTemplate`-shaped JSON proposal from the trace signature + lifecycle payload.
tasks.notes: Mirrors `assembleTemplateFromExecution` in template-generator.ts. CONDITIONAL: fires only when assess_quality reported extractionEligible=true. Output is an `extractedTemplate`-shape impulse for downstream replace-activity / operator consumption.

tasks.description: LLM validates the synthesized template against compliance rules.

config.prompt:
You are validating a ribosome-extracted activityTemplate proposal against compliance rules.

PROPOSAL: {{impulse:extracted_template}}

RULES:
1. id matches /^[a-z0-9-]+$/ (no whitespace, no uppercase).
2. Every task has either prompt.template OR resolver.
3. resolver field (if present) references a known resolver from this set: bash, file, git, llm, impulse-resolve, activity, validation, llm_completion_dispatch, http_fetch, fs_read, fs_write, noop, json_path_extract, iteration, llm-prompt. Vessel-prefixed names (e.g. concept-db:resolve_concept, development-vessel:llm_completion_dispatch) also count as known.
4. tags conform to dot-separated regex /^[a-z0-9.]+$/.
5. At least one task has non-empty inputShapes AND at least one task has non-empty outputShapes.
6. metadata.author is 'ribosome-pattern'.

For each rule, emit an evidence row: { rule: <number>, passed: <bool>, message: <reason on fail, empty on pass> }.

Output EXACTLY this JSON (no markdown, no prose):
{"validator_id":"ribosome-extract::validate_proposal","passed":<bool>,"confidence":<0-1>,"evidence":[{"rule":<n>,"passed":<bool>,"message":"<...>"}]}

tasks.notes: Mirrors replace-activity.json::validate_proposals. Per-rule checks; output is a validation_result-shape impulse with passed flag + evidence rows + validator_id.

tasks.description: Attempt the activityTemplate_write dispatch via http_fetch to activity-api /v2/impulses/resolve.
tasks.notes: Persists the synthesized template via the `activityTemplate_write` write resolver advertised by activity-api. CONDITIONAL: gated on `applyExtraction` variable (default false). When the resolver fails (network, validation, etc.), the chain still completes - extract is best-effort. KNOWN-LIMITATION: activityTemplate_write requires admin scope per CLAUDE.md; canary keys are read,write only, so 401/403 is expected until operator action is taken (next gap if reached). The http_fetch resolver auto-attaches METABOB_API_KEY for substrate-local hosts but the key's scope may not include admin.

tasks.description: Shape-provenance marker (2026-04-27): emit an `activityTemplate` impulse ONLY when the upstream write actually succeeded. Uses noop resolver (dev-vessel proxy) since the impulse pool already contains the registered template body via write_result.
tasks.notes: The conditional substring-matches the write_result impulse content for a success marker (id field present + no error). When applyExtraction was false, dispatch_write_attempt was skipped -> write_result impulse is absent -> this task's conditional fails -> no activityTemplate is registered in the pool. When applyExtraction was true but the write failed (network, 401, validation rejection), write_result contains an error envelope -> the conditional fails -> again no activityTemplate. Only when a real registered template exists on the backend does this task fire and emit the truthful `activityTemplate` shape. Uses noop resolver (no side-effect) since the truthful emission is the output impulse marker itself.

tasks.description: Emits a `learningSummary` + `goalEnd` impulse summarising the ribosome run.
tasks.notes: Conditional on assess_quality having actually produced output. Mirrors make-activity.json::declare_complete. Downstream consumers (workbench history panel, dashboards) consume learningSummary to render the ribosome's learning trail per execution.

metadata.author: ribosome-pattern
metadata.schemaNotes: 2026-06-02 rewrite: legacy `prompt: {template, maxTokens}` on LLM tasks replaced with `resolver: 'llm_completion_dispatch'` + `config: {type, prompt, model, max_tokens}`. Resolution tasks rewritten from `resolver: 'impulse-resolve'` to `resolver: 'http_fetch'` (acquire_trace_signature, dispatch_write_attempt) and `resolver: 'noop'` (dispatch_write_succeeded). All three resolver names are advertised by development-vessel and proxied through goal-host-vessel's registerDevVesselProxies path, so they execute identically to in-substrate authored templates (matches draft-gap-closing-activity.ts pattern). Closes Idiom-6 gap 3 (CORE_IDIOMS.md:239-268).
